details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:331-358 (also 560-575) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not define a channel (stderr, return code or sentinel) for carrying the capped-scan signal and the APPLY_ANALYSIS_CANDIDATE_CAP log out of `unprocessed_docs`, which both callers run via `$(unprocessed_docs)` (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:405, 448).
  WHY: A log on stdout is counted as a doc path, a log on stderr or a global flag does not reach the caller, and rc=2 maps to guard_unavailable, so a capped scan is reported as all_docs_processed or guard_unavailable. Severity is MAJOR in all five sources, mapped here to high.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:346-356 (also 565-576) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The scan_capped_behind_markers signal is conditioned on "no doc printed", but the marker cap can also stop the scan after 1 doc is printed, giving count=1 below PROMOTE_CYCLE_MIN_DOCS.
  WHY: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:798-801 then skips as insufficient_docs, which is the false empty-backlog signal the plan means to remove. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna says MAJOR, the other four say NIT, so the highest is used.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:340-356 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The capped signal fires as soon as the 20th marker skip happens, without checking whether any candidates remain unexamined.
  WHY: With exactly 20 marker-carrying candidates the true outcome is all_docs_processed, but a false scan_capped_behind_markers warning is raised.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:355-358, 565-570 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan requires a WARNING-level alert naming the skipped docs, but `skip_cycle` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:178-185) only echoes and writes an output. No alert helper or skipped-doc output field is named.
  WHY: An implementer must invent the wiring or silently drop the requirement, so the skip goes unalerted.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:342-344 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Raising the marker cap from 6 to 20 raises the per-run ceiling of search and comment reads, and the plan does not weigh that ceiling against the API rate limit.
  WHY: Hitting the limit mid-scan causes a fail-closed guard_unavailable skip, which should be expected. Another reviewer noted that lines 344-345 already state the ceiling.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:434 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The markdown table row uses double leading pipes (`||`), which would break rendering.
  WHY: The phase definitions would not render correctly. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this by grep and could not reproduce it.
- tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py:177 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test name `test_dispatches_oldest_unprocessed_doc_bound_by_label_and_marker_inputs` contradicts the newest-first behavior it tests.
  WHY: It causes confusion during debugging and maintenance. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 noted the name is kept deliberately, with an explanatory comment.
- tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py:179 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test code is indented with tab characters, which the reviewer treats as a style violation.
  WHY: The reviewer says it can cause editor-dependent display issues. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes that tabs are the repo convention.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: P6 adds the new skip reason `scan_capped_behind_markers` to scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh, and each plan phase is independently mergeable and tested.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py (the P6 row, Files & Modules Tests bullet and Tests section of the plan)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The P6 row (line 434), the Files & Modules Tests bullet (lines 600-604) and the Tests section P6 bullet (line 652) name only tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py. tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:526 covers insufficient_docs, but no planned test covers the scan_capped_behind_markers skip path. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite says MAJOR, the others say NIT.
- requirement: P6 says the promote cycle must log `PROMOTE_CYCLE_SKIPPED reason=scan_capped_behind_markers` "with a WARNING alert".
  expected_change_site: P6 implementation steps and files list; .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml and scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: P6 does not include .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml or specify alert credential and delivery wiring. `skip_cycle` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:178-185) only logs and exits, and the workflow step (.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:137-153) provides GH_TOKEN but no Telegram credential.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:331-358, 560-575 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The plan does not say how the capped-scan signal leaves `unprocessed_docs`, which both callers run as `docs_output="$(unprocessed_docs)"` (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh lines 405 and 448).
  WHY: A cap line on stdout is counted as a doc, a global flag is lost in the subshell, and rc=2 is mapped to guard_unavailable.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:346-350 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The signal is conditioned on no doc having been printed, but the marker cap can stop the scan after one doc, giving count=1.
  WHY: promote_main_cycle.sh lines 798-801 then skip as insufficient_docs, the false empty-backlog signal.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:350-356 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cap check fires on the 20th marker skip without checking whether candidates remain unexamined.
  WHY: With exactly 20 marker-carrying docs it logs scan_capped_behind_markers where the true result is all_docs_processed.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:355-358, 566-570 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `skip_cycle` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh lines 178-185) has no alert mechanism, and the list-only line (apply_analysis_on_main.sh line 418) carries no skipped-doc names.
  WHY: An implementer has nowhere to get the skipped doc names or the WARNING alert wiring.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:342-344 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Raising the marker cap from 6 to 20 gives about 23 `doc_dispatched_before` lookups per run, and the plan does not state this against the search API limit.
  WHY: Hitting the limit gives a fail-closed guard_unavailable skip, which should be expected.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Each plan phase is independently mergeable with its own rollback switch, and P6 adds the skip reason `scan_capped_behind_markers` to scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh.
  Expected change site: the Tests section and P6 row of the plan should list a test in tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py.
  Evidence of absence: The P6 row (line 434), the Files & Modules Tests bullet and the P6 test list name only tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py, and no planned test covers the new skip path.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:434 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The markdown table uses double leading pipes (`||`), which causes rendering issues.
  WHY: The plan will not render correctly for the operator.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:331-358 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `unprocessed_docs` is invoked in a subshell `$(...)`, so the planned log lines are captured as stdout and treated as file paths, or are not reported.
  WHY: Log lines parsed as doc paths would cause false dispatches or file-not-found errors.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:346-350 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "no doc printed" condition is fragile, because with 1 doc printed the scan is still capped but insufficient_docs is reported.
  WHY: The operator is left unaware that the scan was capped.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:350-356 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The signal is triggered as soon as the marker cap (20) is reached, even if those were the last candidates.
  WHY: It emits a misleading warning when no candidates remain.
- tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py:177 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test name `test_dispatches_oldest_unprocessed_doc_bound_by_label_and_marker_inputs` contradicts the new newest-first behavior.
  WHY: It causes confusion during debugging and maintenance.
- tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py:179 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test code uses tab characters for indentation.
  WHY: The reviewer says this violates PEP 8 and can cause editor-dependent display issues or a TabError.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "P6 changes scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh (new skip reason scan_capped_behind_markers), and each plan phase is independently mergeable and tested."
  Expected change site: tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py
  Evidence of absence: The P6 row lists only tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py, and tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:526 covers insufficient_docs but nothing covers the new skip path.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:330-364, 560-580, 434 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan names no output channel, exit code or output field to carry the cap log and capped-scan signal out of `unprocessed_docs`, which is invoked via command substitution at scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:405 and :448. The `capped_behind_markers=true` list-only claim is unreachable from inside the function, because the caller builds the APPLY_ANALYSIS_CANDIDATES line at line 418.
  WHY: A stdout log is counted as a doc path. A stderr log leaves the dispatch path returning 0, so the all_docs_processed check (lines 454-456) masks the capped scan.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:347-359, 577-578 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The signal is conditioned on the cap being reached before any doc is printed, so the case of 1-2 docs printed then the cap is not covered by the test bullet.
  WHY: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:800-801 then classifies the cycle as insufficient_docs instead of scan_capped_behind_markers.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:565-570, 678 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan claims a WARNING-level skip naming the skipped docs, but `skip_cycle` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:178-185) is a plain stdout logger with no alert path and no helper is described.
  WHY: An implementer would drop the requirement or invent a notify
